title: Decision: provider serves real unreadCount and lastMessageAt
description: Audit item 2. Base draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L545: with no ReadPosition.lastReadMessageId all messages count as unread; L541 lastMessageAt = received time of the most recent message. The provider has no ReadPosition (.12.29), so the plan's unreadCount 0 is nonconformant. Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-18): unreadCount = count of Messages visible to the account in the Chat; lastMessageAt = latest visible receivedAt; Chat state string folds in the message cursor so each new visible Message changes Chat state.
